visualCharacteristics.structure: intro h3 + p, then equal white rounded cards: centered h4, image, black pill CTA at the bottom
visualCharacteristics.layout: cards stacked on mobile, 2-up from 768px (3-up at 1024px when three cards); intro left-aligned above. Products option: no card chrome, product image (2:1, contained) above a full-width black pill button, 3-up from 768px, rows may omit the heading

contentPattern:
Row 1 (optional, no picture): [h3 + p intro]. Rows 2..n: [h4 + p > a CTA (+ optional second CTA)] | [picture]. Cells are detected by content (order may be swapped); plain CTA links are rendered as pill buttons (first primary, others secondary). Products option rows: [

CTA

(optional h4 above)] | [picture].
